mapper.sql: allocation_confirmed = b'1' AND effective_to IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id AS delivery_scope_id, allocation_version FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY order_line_id, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY order_line_id, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.deliveryScopeId} AND AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE ORDER BY project_id, order_line_id, effective_from DESC, allocation_version DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.limit}

SELECT s.id AS scope_id, o.contract_no, l.order_qty AS order_quantity, l.unit_code FROM com_delivery_scope s LEFT JOIN com_sales_order_line l ON l.id=s.order_line_id AND l.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND l.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND o.deleted=0 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=0
AND s.id IN #{scopeId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id AS scope_id, o.contract_no FROM com_delivery_scope s JOIN com_sales_order_line l ON l.id = s.order_line_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.deleted = b'0' JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.deleted = b'0' WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted = b'0'
AND s.id IN #{scopeId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY s.id
